lead_profile_text: Already on short-term let, self-managed - seeking higher return and eventually hands-off (multi-property owner)
stl_goal: Eventually hands-off; expand to 4-5 properties; more direct bookings
property_situation: Runs 3 self-managed short-lets on Airbnb and Booking.com: Windermere (established, 'runs itself'), the Coach House in the Peak District (opened Feb/March 2026, ~10 reviews, slow on weekdays) and a 2-bed Leicester city-centre penthouse (£1,500/month mortgage). Coach House mortgage £560/month. Superhost on all three (~4.9). Previously had rent-to-rents managed by Pillow Partners and was unhappy with the pricing.
property_type: 2-bed coach house conversion (Chinley, High Peak); also Leicester penthouse and Windermere let
primary_blocker: Control and trust: hands-on host who checks his properties every morning, sceptical that £200+/night is achievable when he is getting £120-£130, wants to see the data himself; winter timing

meeting_flow.opening_phrase: I thought I'd start by just understanding a bit more on your current situation, the situation with the property and, you know, interest in short letting. Then we could go through our figures and our service, see if it sort of lines up with what you're looking for.
rapport_topics: Peak District transport links and walkers
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: Okay, well, I've got the figures here for the, the coach house property.
meeting_flow.income_intro: So we've got gross revenue, which is what it will produce on the platforms, and then the net is what you can expect as a payout, after sort of booking commissions, cleaning, and our management. We reckon about 72% occupancy, about £200, say £210 nightly rate.
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: All right, well, it's an end-to-end service, so to give you an idea of what that includes, setting you up on multiple platforms including our direct booking website.
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: I mean, have you got any concerns about or questions about our sort of management service and how it works... obviously you've been managing this yourself for a while, so there's going to be a level of relinquished control and trust there.
meeting_flow.close_phrase: When do you think it'd be a good time to sort of get in touch? ... do you know when you're sort of wanting to move with this, or is it just sort of preliminary phases?
meeting_flow.meeting_2_ask: I'll send that over to you and then, yeah, we'll touch base.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: How'd you get that nightly rate though? ... What's this platform though? Is it Airbnb? Is it yours?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Rate comes from nearby competitors; the software is Zac's own, pulling data from platforms like Airbnb to show what a payout looks like, not just Airbnb revenue.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: You said I'll get something like £200 plus. I can't see how I'd get that because I've had to drop my figures from like £150 down to like £120 or £130, and when it's last-minute bookings I come even lower.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Explained the review gap: he has ~10 reviews vs a local average of 68; top 4 competitors earn £43k-£68k and take most of the revenue; at 20-40 good reviews things swing his way; short-let is still better than long-let or selling.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Yeah, yeah, yeah. ... like you say, you need at least, well, more than 10

lead_responses.what_lead_said: I find here people go through Booking.com ... most people come from booking.com that book this
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Booking.com and Airbnb share a calendar, so heavy Booking.com momentum squeezes Airbnb availability and lowers Airbnb visibility; Zac's software cannot pull Booking.com data.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: I am 9.4 with Booking.com and I'm about 4.8, I think, with Airbnb.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Are these going to be direct bookings or they're still going to be Airbnb?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: A mix - 20 to 40% direct once momentum builds (later corrected to 10-20% once established because only one source of direct guests); lead on platforms first, push direct when opportunities arise.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Right. Okay. So that's what I want. I want more direct bookings.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: One person lets me down, one person's ill, I'm done, you know what I mean? (about his solo Coach House cleaner)
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: No problem using his existing cleaner; Stayful communicates via WhatsApp, photos after each clean; a cleaner who knows the property works better for us anyway.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: your cleaner is your main person ... she listens and she's nearly there with it now

lead_responses.what_lead_said: I'd be amazed if we could get £200 a night around here ... I just need to see the data you're seeing really so I can see it myself.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Tried to show a Manchester accuracy example (within ~15%) but the screen share would not load; promised to send it afterwards and an emailed action plan with fees, reviews, Year 1 and long-term figures.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: You could send it in an email and I can print it off and I can read it and look into it.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: What's your price? ... I've got your fees in as well. Ah okay, well that'll be good to see ... you see the up here bit, you don't see the down here bit
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: 15% plus VAT; net payout is after management fee, cleans and platform commissions - about £2,000 a month average for the Coach House.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Yeah, and then I go down to my mortgage and my fees, my bills.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: £2,000 a month, did you say again? Yeah, well, you can forget that one then because my mortgage is £1,500. (Leicester penthouse)
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Yeah, okay, so yeah, send me some stuff and then let me have a read. ... just give us a buzz next week.

conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Send the 803 Eastbank Tower case study and a corrected Coach House forecast; drop the monthly breakdown that shows August £0

conversion_gaps.gap: Direct booking potential quoted inconsistently (20-40% then 10-20%)
conversion_gaps.evidence: Zac: "probably sort of 20 to 40% bookings are direct" then "maybe 10 to 20% direct bookings, I would say, once we're sort of established"
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Use 10-20% consistently and disclose the correction in the follow-up email

conversion_gaps.gap: Control and trust barrier not directly worked: lead checks properties every morning and sees them as 'my babies'; question of what happens to existing listing and reviews on handover was never covered
conversion_gaps.evidence: "a job will only get done right if I do it"; Zac asked about relinquished control but conversation moved to cleaners and fees
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Address listing/review continuity and the quarterly review and Slack visibility explicitly on the next call

conversion_gaps.gap: Solo-cleaner single-point-of-failure risk left open while offering to use his cleaner
conversion_gaps.evidence: "One person lets me down, one person's ill, I'm done"
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Position Stayful's backup cleaner network alongside his own cleaner

conversion_gaps.gap: Winter timing and no commitment point: lead said he needs to work it out and asked for a call at the end of the following week
conversion_gaps.evidence: "we're going into a bad period... We're only going to get through winter now"
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Frame spring launch plan and review build-up over winter; follow-up call 16 October

zac_language.numbers_framing: Gross revenue on platforms vs net payout; 72% occupancy and £210 nightly; review-count gap (10 vs 68); Coach House net about £2,000 a month; Leicester about £22,000 net and ruled out against a £1,500 mortgage
zac_language.objection_handling_pattern: Explains the market mechanics behind the objection (reviews, shared calendars) rather than defending the number; agrees honestly when a property will not work (Leicester); but the accuracy demo failed to land

what_they_needed_most: Evidence he keeps control and quality (Superhost, cleaners)
Clarity on what happens to the existing listing and reviews
profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: For experienced self-managing hosts, lead with their own review and rate reality, have a working accuracy case study ready before the call, and address control, listing continuity and the hands-off-later goal before pushing numbers
